root_cause.text: The bridge driver relies on the compile-time check `IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)` instead of a runtime check to determine if IPv6 is active, leading to a NULL pointer dereference of the uninitialized `ipv6_stub->nd_tbl` when processing ICMPv6 Neighbor Discovery packets on systems booted with IPv6 disabled.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces `IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)` with `ipv6_mod_enabled()` in `br_dev_xmit()` and `br_handle_frame_finish()` to ensure Neighbor Discovery suppression is bypassed when IPv6 is disabled at runtime via boot parameters.
